collection.description: A jeweler wants to grind a staining blue mineral into pigment without knowing if the dust is safe.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A mineral leaves brilliant blue marks on skin. A jeweler wants to grind it into pigment without knowing whether the dust is safe.

choices.label: Use it only as an intact stone

a.name: Answer A
a.text: Small controlled tests suggest a useful glaze, though the workshop adopts precautions.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The unusual mineral becomes a striking pendant.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: Several workers cough and the workshop closes pending investigation; the mineral's safety remains uncertain.
